title: Handheld 32GB eMMC operational storage headroom insufficient for Phase XIV reduced profile
summary: Preferred RM121-D8E32 markets 32.0GB but Phase XIV handheld-reduced profile requires 31.5GB (marketed free=0.5GB). After typical eMMC format overhead (~6%), estimated usable≈29.76GB leaves usable_free=-1.74GB when all MLP content is onboard. WP-002 closes with Outcome A: keep 32GB eMMC system-only and require supported microSD expansion with enforced reserves — not an invented larger SKU, not a silent Class E NVMe remux.
recommended_actions: COMPLETED (Outcome A): System-only eMMC + enforced microSD/user-media policy with reserves/reclamation
REJECTED (Outcome B): Larger onboard eMMC/UFS SKU — not present in EXACT_MPN_MATRIX
NOT SELECTED (Outcome C): Class E CR — deferred NVMe remux spike only; not required to close defect
